item.title: Versions
item.description: Speedle releases Use the GitHub Releases page for published versions and release notes. v1.9.0: custom-function failures now fail the decision, functions can declare parameter and result types, the MySQL store uses schema version 2, the js/wasm build accepts a host custom-function caller, and application and audit logging moved to Go log/slog. v1.8.0: removed the experimental policy-distribution feature, source builds require Go 1.27.4 or newer, the container image includes the public CA bundle, and the documentation gained Japanese, Korean and Spanish.
